name: Local service trust ad (geo + proof + call)

hook.visual: Recognizable local cue (shop exterior, city/landmark-adjacent, marque in bay) OR the exact service problem
hook.pattern_interrupt: Hyper-specific geo + job type beats generic ‘best in town’

beats.purpose: Show real facility / team / work in progress
beats.visual: Walk-through or bay shot with real cars/jobs — no stock
beats.vo_or_copy: What you actually do that neighbors search for

beats.visual: Review stars, years badge, association logos you may use, finished job
beats.vo_or_copy: One review line + years + service area
Call / text / form — pick the one you answer fastest

cta.on_screen: Call now · (xxx) xxx-xxxx · Get a quote
cta.landing_promise: Click-to-call and quote form; NAP consistent with GBP

audio_design.music_energy: Light, confident; never cheesy local jingle unless on-brand
audio_design.captions: Phone number on screen for 3+ seconds

visual_system.camera: Phone or simple cinema; stable shop tour
visual_system.color: Brand colors on end card only

why_it_works: Search intent and geo ads need specificity and trust, not cleverness
Real facility footage outperforms stock for local leads
anti_patterns: Vague ‘full service excellence’ without job types

prompt_seeds.script: 20s local trust ad for [shop] in [city]. Hook = city + specialty. Show real bay. Trust stack. End with phone number held 3s.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: Exterior → bay specialty → review overlay → end card with phone

source_notes: Built for geo-intent and local lead gen across service businesses.
